original_example.policy: Allow partial claims and retain undelivered quantity in the same reward entitlement. This is an original design choice, not an API-provided reward policy.
original_example.accounting: Cumulative delivered plus still due equals original entitlement. This is not an equation for current inventory holdings after consumption.
original_example.execution: Paper count illustration only; no API, game, mod, database or test harness run.

deduplication.scope: Gameplay and economy readers, nearby rounding/waiting supports and relevant catalog entries; not a whole-library semantic audit.
deduplication.decision: Optional economy support with conditional reader/shelf entries. No new book or inventory shelf; preserve original all-or-nothing upgrade requirement.

evidence_boundary: Source-backed interface distinction plus original unexecuted accounting. Partial acceptance is neither zero effect nor complete reward delivery. No cross-system consistency, fault recovery, runtime or human-test guarantee.
